cases.name: the signed report requires owned, complete, decodable PNGs
new native releases require observed unlocked user storage in addition to a hidden keyguard
missing and corrupt material leaves sibling flows reusable
a changed responsive matrix only invalidates its owner
secured JSON scenarios compare by their fields and still reject changed execution
APK, source, device profile and cleanup are independent conditions
import replaces only the selected owner and rejects published destinations
the original checkpoint PNG must match its Extent link
repeated original captures may share one Extent image without losing a distinct checkpoint

rule: Every unique original PNG must exist byte-for-byte in Extent; repeated identical captures may share the same inline image. Extra report-owned captures are rejected.
